scope: Exact visible names only; definitions are our operational interpretation, not official Etherscan specifications.

labels.label: Add Liquidity
labels.definition: Contribute assets to an AMM liquidity pool and obtain or increase liquidity ownership. Not merely deposit into a vault or transfer tokens.

labels.label: Approve
labels.definition: Set, increase, decrease or revoke token allowance or NFT operator approval. Require decoded permission operation or approval events; a normal transfer is not approval.

labels.label: Bid
labels.definition: Place or increase an auction/marketplace bid. Require auction/order context, not a token swap or unconditional purchase.

labels.label: Borrow
labels.definition: Receive borrowed assets with a corresponding debt obligation, including flash borrowing if demonstrated. Receiving tokens alone is insufficient.

labels.label: Bridge
labels.definition: Initiate or finalize a cross-chain asset movement supported by a verified bridge contract and bridge/message events. Local token transfer alone is insufficient.

labels.label: Burn
labels.definition: Explicitly destroy tokens or NFTs and reduce supply. Exclude receipt/share burning that is only an implementation detail of redemption, withdrawal or unwrapping.

labels.label: Cancel
labels.definition: Cancel an order, bid, proposal or commitment. Use Cancel Withdrawal instead for a withdrawal cancellation; no action occurred when a transaction reverted.

labels.label: Cancel Withdrawal
labels.definition: Cancel a previously requested or queued withdrawal, restoring its prior state. Not execution failure or a completed withdrawal.

labels.label: Claim
labels.definition: Collect an already-earned reward, distribution, airdrop or matured entitlement. Not receiving an unsolicited transfer; separate from redeeming investment shares.

labels.label: Collateralize
labels.definition: Explicitly enable or add collateral backing a debt. Generic supplying/depositing is insufficient without collateral evidence.

labels.label: Commit
labels.definition: Record a commitment for a later reveal/registration/auction step. Require commitment semantics, not generic writes or transactions.

labels.label: Complete Withdrawal
labels.definition: Finalize a previously queued or initiated withdrawal after its delay/proof stage. Requires evidence of the staged withdrawal lifecycle.

labels.label: Create
labels.definition: Create a protocol entity such as a pool, market, order or proposal. Pure EVM deployment uses Deploy; token/NFT issuance uses Mint.

labels.label: De-collateralised
labels.definition: Explicitly disable collateral or release pledged backing. Not any token withdrawal, and not liquidation.

labels.label: Delegate
labels.definition: Delegate governance votes, staking authority or validation stake to a representative/validator. ERC20 spending allowance uses Approve.

labels.label: Deploy
labels.definition: Successful EVM contract creation, including factory-created contracts proven by creation traces. New protocol records alone use Create.

labels.label: Deposit
labels.definition: Credit assets to a protocol/vault/custody account or a positively identified exchange deposit account. Verified wrapper deposit is allowed alongside Wrap. Ordinary address transfers without destination identity do not qualify. Lending Supply and Stake alone do not automatically imply this broader tag.

labels.label: Extend Lock
labels.definition: Extend the expiration time of an existing asset lock. Not creating a new lock or increasing its principal.

labels.label: Increase Amount
labels.definition: Increase principal in an existing asset lock. Require locking context; unrelated balance increases or approvals do not qualify.

labels.label: Initiate Redemption
labels.definition: Submit a redemption request to a staged redemption queue; payout not yet completed. Immediate share-to-asset settlement uses Redeem.

labels.label: Initiate Withdrawal
labels.definition: Start a staged/queued withdrawal or unbonding request, with completion still pending. Immediate withdrawal uses Withdraw.

labels.label: Liquidate
labels.definition: Execute forced debt/collateral liquidation against a borrower. Not voluntary selling, repaying or withdrawing.

labels.label: Lock
labels.definition: Establish a new time lock or escrow restricting assets. Do not infer from any contract custody, normal staking or bridge escrow alone.

labels.label: Migrate
labels.definition: Move an existing protocol position or token version into its replacement using a migration mechanism. Generic transfer or swap is insufficient.

labels.label: Mint
labels.definition: Issue new tokens or NFTs as the intended operation. Exclude auxiliary receipt/share minting during liquidity provision, wrapping, staking or vault deposits.

labels.label: Redeem
labels.definition: Exchange/burn an existing investment share, voucher or claim token for its underlying assets in a settled redemption. Not just claiming rewards or requesting later redemption.

labels.label: Refund
labels.definition: Return a prior payment or bid due to refund/cancellation/excess-payment logic. Arbitrary inbound transfer and investment exit do not qualify.

labels.label: Register
labels.definition: Register a domain, identity, name, operator or protocol membership. A commitment before registration uses Commit.

labels.label: Remove Liquidity
labels.definition: Reduce AMM liquidity ownership and receive constituent assets. Not general vault withdrawal or redemption.

labels.label: Renew
labels.definition: Extend an existing domain/name/service registration term. Time-lock extension uses Extend Lock.

labels.label: Repay
labels.definition: Pay borrowed principal or interest to reduce an actual debt. Ordinary payment to a contract is insufficient.

labels.label: Restake
labels.definition: Use already-staked assets or staking claims to secure an additional restaking service. Repeating an ordinary stake does not qualify.

labels.label: Sale
labels.definition: Settle a marketplace/auction sale with asset ownership exchanged for payment. AMM token trading uses Swap; placing a bid is not a completed sale.

labels.label: Short
labels.definition: Open or increase a short derivatives/margin position with explicit short-side evidence. Selling held tokens does not qualify.

labels.label: Stake
labels.definition: Commit tokens to a staking system for validation or staking rewards. Plain vault deposits, lending supply and generic locks are insufficient.

labels.label: Supply
labels.definition: Supply assets to a lending money market, crediting the lender account. Different from AMM Add Liquidity and generic vault Deposit.

labels.label: Swap
labels.definition: Exchange one asset for another through an exchange or routing protocol. Exclude wrapping/unwrapping of the same underlying asset and simple transfers.

labels.label: Undelegate
labels.definition: Remove or reduce a previous governance/validator delegation. Token spending allowance revocation is Approve.

labels.label: Unlock
labels.definition: Release assets from an existing lock/escrow. Passage of time alone without a transaction is not an action; ordinary Withdraw is not automatically Unlock.

labels.label: Unstake
labels.definition: Remove tokens from ordinary staking and reduce staked balance. Can coexist with Initiate Withdrawal only if both operations are evidenced.

labels.label: Unwrap
labels.definition: Convert a wrapped representation back to its underlying asset through the wrapper. Receipt redemption in a vault is Redeem, not Unwrap.

labels.label: Update Interest
labels.definition: Execute an interest accrual update or change an interest rate/model. Merely receiving yield or a swap price update does not qualify.

labels.label: Vote
labels.definition: Cast a governance vote on a proposal. Delegation alone is Delegate; prediction-market betting is not governance voting.

labels.label: Withdraw
labels.definition: Immediately remove credited assets from a protocol/account. Wrapper withdrawal is allowed alongside Unwrap. Prefer Complete Withdrawal for staged completion and Remove Liquidity for AMM exit.

labels.label: Wrap
labels.definition: Convert a native/underlying asset to its corresponding wrapped representation through a wrapper. Not a market swap between unrelated assets.
